nav.show.caption: Browse nodes
nav.tree.caption: The graph of nodes
nav.new.caption: Create a new node
nav.lang.label: Choose a language
upload.drop: Drag and drop Images Here to Upload
editor.label: Node editor
editor.title.label: Title
editor.context.empty: Select something on the stage to edit it.
editor.place.queued: Will be linked to {place} when the node is saved
editor.place.failed: The place could not be linked, try again
editor.tool.wand: Magic wand: tap the part to keep
upload.retention: Photos you add are kept on the server for {days} days, then deleted automatically. Only you can see them. Photos in a saved work are kept as long as the work exists, and everyone who can open the work can see them.
upload.retention.original: Until you save, the original file is kept as you uploaded it. When a work is saved, its photos are resized and camera data such as the location is removed.
upload.retention.cookie: Uploads belong to this browser. If you clear its cookies you can no longer reach them; they are deleted when they expire.
upload.retention.delete: A saved work and its photos are deleted by opening the work and choosing Delete.
upload.sweep.title: Delete all uploads
upload.sweep.hint.one: Removes {count} photo that is not in a work. Saved works keep theirs.
upload.sweep.hint.other: Removes {count} photos that are not in a work. Saved works keep theirs.
upload.sweep.editor.one: {count} photo in the work you are editing stays until you save or close it.
upload.sweep.editor.other: {count} photos in the work you are editing stay until you save or close it.
upload.sweep.confirm.one: Delete {count} photo now? This cannot be undone.
upload.sweep.confirm.other: Delete {count} photos now? This cannot be undone.
editor.saved.kept.one: {count} photo is now part of this work and is kept. The work is public.
editor.saved.kept.other: {count} photos are now part of this work and are kept. The work is public.
editor.context.pen: Draw on the stage with the pen.
editor.replace.confirm: Another node is open. Close it and open this one?
editor.context.label: Selection controls
editor.dropper: Take a colour from the picture
editor.announce.dropper: Tap the stage to take a colour
editor.draft.found: An unsaved draft from {time} was found.
editor.close.confirm: There are unsaved changes. Close the editor anyway? They stay as a draft.
editor.page.remove.confirm: This page has steps. Remove it anyway?
editor.scrub.preview: Showing the first steps only. Move a photo here to record a move, or slide to the end to edit.
editor.mode.auto: The grid arranges the photos by itself. Switch to Free or Slides to edit.
editor.shape.hint: Click for a corner, drag to pull a curve, click the first corner to close.
editor.context.clip: Select a photo, then draw around the part to keep, or across the photo to cut it in two. Tapping a shape masks the photo with it.
editor.context.wand: Select a photo, then tap the part to keep. Tap more places to add; the outline refines when the sharper pass is done.
editor.announce.wandFailed: The wand could not find an outline
editor.context.unclip: Tap a masked photo to free it again.
editor.save.error.invalid: The node is not valid and could not be saved.
editor.save.error.too_large: The node is too large to save.
editor.save.error.missing_photo: A photo is missing on the server. Upload it again.
editor.save.error.bake_failed: A photo could not be processed.
editor.save.error.conflict: The node was changed elsewhere in the meantime.
editor.save.error.locked: Someone else is editing this node.
editor.save.error.forbidden: You may not change this node.
editor.save.error.network: Network error. Nothing was lost; try again.
editor.conflict.title: Changed elsewhere
editor.conflict.text: This node was saved by someone else, or in another tab, after you opened it.
editor.load.error: The node could not be loaded.
editor.lock.lost: The lock was lost (expired or broken). Your changes are kept as a draft; take the lock back to continue.
editor.lock.gone: This node no longer exists. Your changes are kept as a draft.
editor.delete.confirm: Delete this node for good? Its photos go too, unless another node uses them. This cannot be undone.
editor.role.hint: Texture for the 3D scene: not drawn as a picture
editor.announce.candidate: Mask shape chosen. Press Enter to use it.
editor.clip.none: Close the shape, or draw across the photo.
editor.context.text: Tap the stage to place a caption and type. Tap outside or press Esc to finish; an empty box is discarded.
editor.export.error: The picture could not be made.
editor.keys.hint: Keyboard: see the Keys list. PageDown and PageUp select the next or previous step, the arrow keys move it.
editor.keys.V P S C U T: Pick a tool: select, pen, shape, clip, unclip, text
editor.keys.PageDown PageUp: Select the next or previous step (in the clip tool: the next mask shape)
editor.keys.Escape: Let go of the selection, then back to the select tool
editor.keys.Arrows: Move the selection by 1 (Shift: 10); in the shape tool the cursor by 10 (Shift: 50)
editor.keys.[ ]: Send backward or forward (Shift: to the back or front)
editor.keys.Delete: Delete the selection, or the selected corner
editor.keys.\\\\: Select the next corner of a shape (Shift: previous); arrows then move the corner
editor.keys.Space: Shape tool: place a corner at the cursor; on the first corner it closes
editor.keys.Enter: Finish an open shape, or apply the chosen mask
upload.crop.hint.x: Drag sideways to choose the part of the photo shown
upload.crop.hint.y: Drag up or down to choose the part of the photo shown
editor.layout.loose.hint: A margin and a gap between the photos
editor.layout.tight.hint: As much of the stage as possible is covered by photos
editor.wall.acute: A wall may not have a corner sharper than 90 degrees (this one is {angle}).
editor.wall.gallery: Walls only exist in a gallery node: set the kind to gallery first.
editor.keys.W: The selected shape becomes a wall (gallery) or stops being one
graph.label: Graph of the nodes
graph.linkTo: Tap the node to link to
graph.hint: Drag to move and pin, tap to select, wheel over a node resizes the nodes
editor.keys.I: Dropper: take the colour being set from the picture
graph.multi: {n} selected. Drag one to carry them: drop on a node to link them all, on empty space to line them up
graph.carry.line: Release to line up {n} nodes here
graph.group.title: Group
editor.flow.hint: How the viewer shows the node
editor.announce.busy: The background of this photo is being removed: wait or cancel first
editor.close.job: A job on the server is still running and is lost when you close. Close anyway?
